Select compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1865 with exact IC50 values in nM. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter by assay CHEMBL1865, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL. Require compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
